package rulefixtures

import (
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_hot_path_optimization_invariant_parse_inside_handler: Layer: Hot path optimization. Flag handlers that parse invariant templates, schemas, or expressions per request.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func GreetHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	tmpl, err := template.New("greet").Parse("<h1>Hello, {{.Name}}!</h1>")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "template error", 500)
		return
	}
	name := r.URL.Query().Get("name")
	tmpl.Execute(w, map[string]string{"Name": name})
}

func ProfileHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	tmpl, err := template.New("profile").Parse("<p>User: {{.User}} | Role: {{.Role}}</p>")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "template error", 500)
		return
	}
	tmpl.Execute(w, map[string]string{"User": "alice", "Role": "admin"})
}
